audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 with Neeko favored early (levels 1-5) and even from first item on matches the packet win rate (49.32%) and level chart (Neeko x5, Skill x2).
Neeko's spikes (lvl2 Q+E root, lvl6 Pop Blossom) and Poppy's item/tank spike at first-item are already reflected in phases[] and spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable kit interactions were unmentioned: Poppy's R (Keeper's Verdict) makes her untargetable through a committed burst window, and her P (Iron Ambassador) buckler shield absorbs a chunk of burst before an all-in. Also wants.you[1]/wants.foe[0] wrongly describe her stun as an 'E-W' combo — Heroic Charge (E) alone pushes into a wall for the stun; there is no W component to the chain.
audit.why: missingInteractions flagged untargetable-dodges-burst and shield-absorbs-burst as applicable but absent from text; the E-W phrasing is a fabricated ability chain not supported by the kit (W is Steadfast Presence, a separate grounding tool).
audit.corrected: Folded the R/P interactions into report[5] Key Ability Interactions; fixed the E-only wall-stun wording in wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0].
